metrics.name: fragment_vs_word_onset_similarity

regions.explanation: At 21.02s, the onset of “of” is repeated 2 time(s) before the word is completed (fragment-to-onset spectral similarity 1.00). Repeated onsets before the word is completed fragment it and interrupt the speech rhythm. Fix: Begin the word once, deliberately; a short breath before it helps.
